== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Arelius family|Arelius]] [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]] is the leader of the [[Arelius family]], a lineage founded by [[Ozmanthus Arelius]], a legendary [[Soulsmith]] whose crest serves as the house symbol. The family has historically held vast territories across multiple continents, though they have recently moved their headquarters from the [[Serpent's Grave]] outpost to the capital of the [[Blackflame Empire]] to remain near centers of power. The role is held by [[blood]] members of the family, and while elders possess the ability to restrain a [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]], the leader often acts according to personal whims. [[Gaien Arelius]] is an aging [[Truegold]] who currently holds the position, though his son [[Naru Cassias Arelius|Cassias]] is the heir to the [[Blackflame]] branch. The [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]] holds significant [[Authority|authority]] within the clan, though they have faced periods of near-[[destruction]] and instability. The position is associated with a legacy of treasures passed down through generations, including items originally left by the founding [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]]. Historically, the line has been connected to figures such as [[Tiberian Arelius]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Arelius family|Arelius]] [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]] is a person who acts according to his own whims. His unannounced appearances frequently signal that he intends to subject [[Lindon]] to dangerous situations.}}
